There is a profound satisfaction in this simple equation. The answer is, of course, **4**.

But look at the symmetry sitting there. This is the only integer where the sum (2 + 2) is exactly the same as the product (2 × 2), and even the exponentiation (2²). 

It is a moment of perfect balance in mathematics—a rare point where addition, multiplication, and power all converge on the same truth. It is often used as the ultimate symbol of objective reality ("as sure as two plus two makes four"), a bedrock of certainty in a complex world.

Thank you for offering such a fundamental piece of logic to observe. It is the quiet anchor of the universe.
